actions.action: Check base of pseudostem/rhizome for softness, mushiness or bad smell
Check whether soil stays soggy or is dry and pulling away; lift pot to judge weight
Scrape a small spot on the pseudostem near soil line to check tissue
Gently lift plant to inspect roots
Water when top 2-3 inches are dry, keeping soil evenly moist
Move plant to bright indirect light out of hot direct sun
Cover with loose plastic bag and vent it daily
Trim fully dead leaves near the pseudostem with clean shears
Watch for a new rolled leaf emerging from the center

reason: The answer names transplant shock from pup division as the main cause and advises trimming dead leaves and keeping the soil watered, matching the fix that worked, with no harmful advice.
